## About Me

Sam Ottoy is a researcher specialising in the domains of geographical information systems, urban ecosystems, wildfire risk assessments and drone remote sensing. He holds a PhD in Bioscience Engineering from KU Leuven.

---

## Research Interests

* Urban greening
* Wildfire risk assessments
* Geographical Information Systems
* Drone remote sensing


---

* Metsu, C. (corresp. author), Maes, W.H., Ottoy, S., Van Meerbeek, K. (2026). theRmalUAV: An R package to clean and correct thermal UAV data for accurate land surface temperatures. METHODS IN ECOLOGY AND EVOLUTION, 17 (2), 488-496.  https://doi.org/10.1111/2041-210x.70196
